sections.title: THE GAME
sections.content: **Space Age Racer** is an arcade racing game inspired by the podracers from Star Wars. You pilot a pod with two levers, one for each engine. I made it for fun, to race with my friends while learning more about Unity and Arduino.

sections.title: THE CONTROLLER
sections.content: The idea was a homemade arcade game, played on [a controller](media:-2) I built out of wood. Each lever is linked to a **potentiometer**, with a boost button on the right handle. An **Arduino** sends it all to the game.

sections.title: DESIGN CHALLENGES
sections.content: I developed **the whole game in Unity**. The real challenge was making the levers feel natural to drive, which meant reworking almost everything, again and again. I also built several prototype tracks to test different ideas, with my friends as playtesters. Little by little, racing started to feel fun.
